The original Fly Managed Postgres runs on FKS. That caused some stability problems due to the unique problems that come with that. Managed Postgres v2 is built directly on Fly Machines, Fly networking, Flycast, and the same primitives the rest of your Fly apps use. The main goal is stability. v2 was designed to make managed Postgres more predictable operationally: fewer moving parts, clearer ownership of the runtime, and a foundation we can keep improving without fighting the old architecture. For now, v2 beta is only available in `dfw` and we are looking to expand it to more regions over time.
